findings.method: inspection of pytest addopts vs CI -m expressions and @pytest.mark.slow sites
findings.observation: Global addopts -m 'not benchmark and not slow' is AND-combined with every CLI -m, so @pytest.mark.slow tests are not collected in canonical lanes or Tests/E2E/architecture jobs unless addopts is cleared.
findings.expected: Named slow/governance/e2e/security lanes can execute @pytest.mark.slow owners; CI has an explicit slow-lane with -o addopts= or addopts does not embed -m.
findings.actual: addopts includes '-m', 'not benchmark and not slow'. CI jobs pass additional -m but do not use -o addopts=. Slow owners include tests/security/test_security.py TestVCRCassetteSanitization, tests/e2e/test_full_pipeline_chain_e2e.py (module pytestmark slow), tests/architecture/test_layer_dependencies.py::test_import_linter_contracts, and live contract @pytest.mark.slow methods. Only security.yml detect-secrets and pre-commit clear addopts for one architecture test.
findings.impact: VCR cassette secret sanitization, full-chain e2e, and several architecture/security/contract slow tests never run on PR or monthly contract workflow; green lanes do not prove those risks.
findings.root_cause: pytest combines multiple -m expressions with AND; global exclusion was used as a local-speed default without a compensating slow-lane.
findings.remediation: Remove -m from pyproject addopts (keep exclusion in named lane marker_expression) OR add a canonical slow lane that runs with -o addopts= and attach TestVCRCassetteSanitization plus architecture/e2e slow owners. Do not raise skip budgets.
validation: pytest --collect-only -q -m slow  (expect empty under current addopts)
grep -n 'not benchmark and not slow' pyproject.toml .github/workflows/*.yml
findings.automation: architecture test: assert no -m in addopts OR every @pytest.mark.slow nodeid is owned by a CI job that passes -o addopts=

findings.method: inspection of governance SSOT for ruleset enforcement; workflows inspected; live GitHub API not re-queried this session
findings.observation: Documented GitHub ruleset enforcement on main is disabled; PR test workflows are recommended quality gates, not merge-blocking required checks.
findings.expected: Merge/release cannot land without the project-defined test/coverage/architecture required checks (RULES §4.2, ADR-042 coverage-verify).
findings.actual: 05-github-policy.md (activated/re-verified 2026-08-19) states: no live required-check ruleset; direct push and merge to main allowed; root-hygiene-required-check enforcement=disabled. Live API this session: NOT_PROVEN.
findings.impact: A red Tests/coverage-verify/arch-tests workflow does not prevent merge to main; regression-detection is social, not enforced.
findings.root_cause: Explicit operator/ruleset policy; not a missing workflow.
findings.remediation: Maintainer-only: re-enable ruleset after confirming always-on contexts (checks-complete, root-hygiene) plus path-scoped coverage-verify. Do not silently treat workflow presence as merge truth. Out of MODE=audit patch scope.

evidence.observation: Updates to main are not blocked by a live required-check ruleset

findings.method: compare test_matrix.yaml parallel_execution_policy with tests.yml pytest invocations and serial markers under tests/integration
findings.observation: CI runs unit-fast and integration shards with xdist -n auto while test_matrix.yaml lists unit-fast and integration-replay as serial_or_bounded_lanes; VCR integration tests are almost never marked serial.
findings.expected: VCR-backed replay stays serial/bounded unless cassette isolation is proven xdist-safe; serial_or_bounded lanes do not inherit implicit xdist.
findings.actual: test-fast line 840 and test-matrix line 1144 use '-n auto --dist loadscope'. integration-replay is serial_or_bounded. rg @pytest.mark.serial under tests/integration found only tests/integration/infrastructure/storage/test_atomic.py. Many @pytest.mark.vcr integration tests exist without serial.
findings.impact: Order-dependent or cassette-write races can flake or skip; local serial default diverges from CI, hiding isolation bugs.
findings.root_cause: CI speed shortcut vs lane policy; serial marker not applied to VCR tests.
findings.remediation: Either mark VCR integration tests serial and keep test-matrix excluding serial, or move a proven-xdist-safe subset into explicit_parallel_lanes and document cassette isolation. Do not add retries.

findings.method: read matrix smoke exception handling for VCR mismatch
findings.observation: For pipelines not in CRITICAL_SMOKE_PIPELINES, VCR cassette mismatch in playback is pytest.skip (INFRA_FLAKY_CASSETTE_MISMATCH) rather than fail.
findings.expected: Playback mismatch is a code or cassette regression (fail-closed) or a timeboxed quarantine row; retries/skips are not used to heal flakes (e2e_skip_rate_slo policy).
findings.actual: CRITICAL_SMOKE_PIPELINES fail on mismatch; others skip. Deferred pipelines are already absent from ACTIVE_PIPELINE_CASES, so remaining active non-critical cases can skip on mismatch.
findings.impact: Adapter/pipeline regressions on non-critical active matrix rows can look green via skip, consuming skip-rate budget instead of failing the job (job still fails only if pytest exit != 0; skip is exit 0).
findings.root_cause: Intentional sparse-cassette tolerance mixed with flaky classification.
findings.remediation: Fail closed on mismatch, or move those rows to deferred with an owner test elsewhere. Do not add reruns.
findings.automation: architecture test forbidding pytest.skip on VCR mismatch for ACTIVE_PIPELINE_CASES

findings.method: compare documented pytest -m slow recipe with addopts AND semantics

findings.expected: Documented slow-run command actually collects slow tests.
findings.actual: testing.md shows pytest -m 'not slow' as the exclusion example and lists slow as a selectable marker. CHANGELOG claims run explicitly with pytest -m slow. pre-commit correctly uses -o addopts=.
findings.impact: Contributors think they ran slow tests; they did not.
findings.root_cause: Same as TEST-SYS-001 plus stale docs.
findings.remediation: Document pytest -o addopts= -m slow (Windows: .\.venv-win\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -o addopts= -m slow).
